March 24 34.

Dear Mr. Steptoe,

I note the contents of your letter of
March 23, 1934 on the subject of Kulchitsky and
forward herewith for your information copy of a
further report on the movements of this individual
and his son.

Yours sincerely,

H.N. Steptoe, Esq.,

SECRET & CONFIDENTIAL

Dear Robertson,

With reference to my letter to Givens
of March 13th on the subject of MICHEL KULCHITSKY.
It now appears probable that on the
"Andre Lebon" he was in touch with members of the
French deputation of the "International Red Aid"
on its way to Indo-China on a tour of investigation.

Yours sincerely,
Hulbert

SECRET
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / File No. B: REGISTRY. / No. D 5752 / Station, / Date 21 / 3 / 34）
Date March 23, 1934

Subject (in full) I.P. Kulchitsky and Son.

Made by D.S. Jones Forwarded by J.B.Ru. A.I.

It has been ascertained that on March 10, 1934 I.P.
Kulchitsky, together with his son Vladimir, sailed from
Shanghai for Hsinking, via Dairen, on the s.s. Tsingtao Maru,
travelling 3rd class.

Kulchitsky senior obtained a Chinese passport - No. 3153 -
issued at Shanghai on March 6, 1934. His son is travelling on
the same passport, the latter's former Chinese passport, No.
2491, being retained by the Chinese Passport Authorities.

When making the application for the passport for himself
and son, Kulchitsky described himself on this occasion as
"Former Russian".

House No. 2, 925 Avenue Joffe, where Kulchitsky stayed
from February 28 to March 10 is the place of abode of one
Angarsky, reported to be in charge of G.P.U. activities in
Shanghai.

D.S. Jones
D.S.

Deputy Commissioner,
Special Branch
Spare copy prepared - marked D.S. 23/3.

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 档案号 B: 登记处。/ 编号 D 5752 / 警署，/ 日期 34年3月21日）
日期 1934年3月23日

主题（全称） I.P. 库尔奇茨基及其子。

撰写人 D.S. 琼斯 转呈人 J.B.Ru. A.I.

经查实，1934年3月10日，I.P. 库尔奇茨基与其子弗拉基米尔（Vladimir）乘坐“青岛丸”号轮船，经大连前往新京（Hsinking），乘坐三等舱。

老库尔奇茨基持有一本中国护照——编号3153——于1934年3月6日在上海签发。其子使用同一本护照旅行，后者原有的中国护照，编号2491，已被中国护照当局留存。

在为自己和儿子申请护照时，库尔奇茨基在此次自称是“前俄罗斯人”。

茹费理路925号2室，即库尔奇茨基从2月28日至3月10日的住处，是一名叫安加尔斯基（Angarsky）的人的住所，据报此人负责国家政治保卫总局（G.P.U.）在上海的活动。

D.S. 琼斯
D.S.

副总监，
特别股

SECRET
REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. B. REGISTRY.
S. No. D 5752
Station 23 / 3
Date March 22, 1934

Subject (in full) M. P. Kulchitsky and Son, Soviet Russians

Made by D.S. Jones Forwarded by J.B.Ru. D.I.

Mihail Pavlovitch Kulchitsky, born 1888, and his son,
Vladimir M. Kulchitsky, age 11 years, arrived at Shanghai on
February 28, 1934 from Marseilles on board the s.s. "Andre Lebon".
The father is travelling on U.S.S.R. passport No. 15771, issued
at Harbin on March 17, 1926. His occupation is given as "Landlord
of Harbin" and the object of trip "Returning home". On the Alien's
Registration Form, from which the above particulars were taken, he
describes himself as a resident of Shanghai and gives his address
in Shanghai as No. 925 Avenue Joffre.

Whereas M.P. Kulchitsky gives his own nationality as Soviet
Russian, he gives that of his son as "Former Russian". The most
likely explanation for this is that during a previous visit to
Shanghai (August 23, 1933) Kulchitsky, who at the time is en
route to Berlin, where his son was to undergo an operation, prob-
ably found it necessary to get the latter a separate passport
before he could proceed on the journey. On August 24, 1933 his
son was issued by the local Chinese Authorities with Passport
No.2491, on which he recently travelled from Marseilles to
Shanghai with his father. At that time the local U.S.S.R.
Consulate-General had not reopened, consequently it could not
have been possible for Kulchitsky senior to obtain for the son a
U.S.S.R. passport at short notice, and so, it seems, he had
recourse to the Chinese Authorities, describing his son as a
"former Russian", in order to obtain the Chinese passport issued
on August 24.

From February 28, 1934 to March 10 Kulchitsky resided at
House No. 2, 925 Avenue Joffre ; his present whereabouts are not
known.

Deputy Commissioner, Special Branch
D.S. Jones

序列号 D 5752
警署 3月23日
日期 1934年3月22日

主题（全称） M. P. 库尔奇茨基及其子，苏维埃俄罗斯人

撰写人 D.S. 琼斯 转呈人 J.B.Ru. D.I.

米哈伊尔·帕夫洛维奇·库尔奇茨基（Mihail Pavlovitch Kulchitsky），生于1888年，及其子弗拉基米尔·M·库尔奇茨基（Vladimir M. Kulchitsky），11岁，于1934年2月28日乘坐“安德烈·勒邦”号轮船从马赛抵达上海。父亲持有苏联护照，编号15771，于1926年3月17日在哈尔滨签发。其职业填写为“哈尔滨房东”，旅行目的为“回家”。在上述信息所源自的外侨登记表上，他自称为上海居民，并给出其在上海的地址为茹费理路925号。

虽然 M.P. 库尔奇茨基将自己的国籍列为苏维埃俄罗斯人，但他将其子的国籍列为“前俄罗斯人”。对此最可能的解释是，在此前访问上海期间（1933年8月23日），当时正前往柏林的库尔奇茨基（其子将在那里接受手术），可能发现有必要在为儿子办理单独护照后才能继续行程。1933年8月24日，当地中国当局向其子签发了编号为2491的护照，他最近正是凭此护照与父亲一起从马赛前往上海。当时，苏联驻上海总领事馆尚未重新开馆，因此老库尔奇茨基不可能在短时间内为儿子获得苏联护照，所以，看来他是向中国当局求助，将其子描述为“前俄罗斯人”，以便获得8月24日签发的中国护照。

从1934年2月28日至3月10日，库尔奇茨基居住在茹费理路925号2室；其目前下落不明。

D.S. 琼斯

SPECIAL ENQUIRY FROM OFFICER I/C SPECIAL BRANCH

Two Soviet subjects named MICHEL KULCHITSKY
and his son sailed for the Far East on board s.s.
"Andre Lebon" from Marseilles on January 26th.
He passed through Hongkong on February 25th
as third class passengers on that vessels, and
probably landed here.
I should be obliged if you could inform
me if this is so, and where this man is now living.
Any details which you may be able to
obtain concerning him and his associates would be
most valuable.

James.
O.S. Fehermansky SSB.
Please make discreet
enquiries and report early.

Date 23 / 3 / 34
March 15th, 1934

Dear Givens,

Two Soviet subjects named MICHEL KULCHITSKY
and his son sailed for the Far East on board s.s.
"Andre Lebon" from Marseilles on January 26th.

He passed through Hongkong on February
25th as third class passengers on that vessel, and
probably landed here.

I should be obliged if you could inform
me if this is so, andwhere this man is now living.

Any details which you may be able to
obtain concerning him and his associates would be most
valuable.

Yours sincerely,
（签名）

T. Givens Esq.,
